newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha hits five-year high on crude rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha hits five-year high on crude rally.

text.p: Naphtha prices rose to a five-year high in Tokyo afternoon trade on Tuesday, surpassing the previous high marked on Monday, traders said.
The surge was largely attributed to firmer overseas oil markets, they added.

Open-spec naphtha for first-half December was quoted at $223.50/$224.50, up sharply from Monday's $218.50/$220.00. Second-half December was assessed at around $222.50/$223.50, compared with $217.75/$219.25 in late trading on Monday.
A year ago, first-half December cargoes were mainly traded at about $160.00.
